## Findings
- claim-1: The supplied local documentation identifies arXiv:0809.2981v2 as a different paper, published in *Transactions of the American Mathematical Society* 363 (2011), 521–543. [source-6@L3-L8|claim=ordinary-document]
- claim-2: No supplied citable full-text artifact has a bibliographic page recording DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\), nor is any stable artifact identifier, digest, page/line text, or exhaustive search output for that DOI supplied.
## Strategy
No target full-text artifact, bibliographic DOI page, stable artifact identifier, digest, page/line passages, or search-index witness is supplied. No affirmative certificate can be constructed without inventing evidence.

## Gaps
All required certificate components remain missing: explicit DOI page, artifact ID, SHA-256 digest, indexed full theorem, coefficient-ring and \(J_v,A_+\) definitions, quotient occurrences, and exhaustive reproducible search results.

## Next
Ingest and deterministically text-index a complete DOI-specific artifact, then record the required immutable metadata and exact passages. The named certificate is not established.
